offer.text: I mean to map the lands past the ridge, but my desk is bare. Bring me 8 paper and we'll begin the first survey.

accept.text: Wonderful. Every great map starts with a blank page.

decline.text: No matter — the frontier isn't going anywhere.

in_progress.text: Any paper yet? My quills are restless.

ready.text: Crisp, clean sheets — perfect. Let's get to work.

complete.text: A fine start. Come back and we'll push past the ridge together.
